prompt: What will happen to certificates for participants who were absent?
promptZh: 缺席者的證書會如何處理？

options.text: They will be mailed to the participants.
options.whyZh: 計分台說不會郵寄缺席者的證書。

options.text: They will be displayed on the hall board.
options.whyZh: 看板已撤下，證書會留在服務台。
訊息只說目前尚未印製，以及印好後缺席者的證書會保留，並未取消印製。

options.text: They will be kept at the welcome desk.
options.whyZh: 計分台說缺席者的證書會留在迎賓服務台，不另郵寄。

explanationZh: 計分台說缺席者的證書會留在迎賓服務台，不另郵寄。
evidence: We will hold certificates for absent participants at the welcome desk rather than mailing them.

vocabulary.note: hold 在此表示替未到場者保管。

difficultyRationale: 一處直接資訊，與計分、加總與複查規則無關。
